sharedView.title: SHARED VIEW
sharedView.scanDescription: Opens the canonical TrackDraw share link for mobile review and briefing.
sharedView.noShareDescription: Publish this project first if you want the Race Pack to include a scan code.

cover.title: Race Pack
cover.intro: This Race Pack is meant to travel with the build crew on race day. Use the map as the placement reference, the material list as the stock check, and the setup sequence as the practical order to get the course on the field. The setup timing is based on a typical 2-3 person crew and a club-style workflow: unload, stage, pre-assemble, then place and secure.
cover.contentsItem2: 2. Material list, stock check, and timing points
cover.summaryShortage: {count, plural, one {This layout currently exceeds available stock in 1 obstacle type.} other {This layout currently exceeds available stock in {count} obstacle types.}} Resolve shortages before using this pack as the final build reference.
cover.summaryBuildable: This layout is currently buildable with the saved inventory profile. Use the following pages as the race-day setup and handoff reference.

buildSheet.title: Build sheet
buildSheet.noTimingPoints: No timing points are assigned yet. Mark a gate as start/finish or split in the inspector before race-day handoff.
buildSheet.setupIntro: Estimated setup effort: about {min}-{max} minutes. Overall complexity: {complexity}. {summary}
buildSheet.noSetupSequenceNumbering: No setup sequence is available yet. Add a route and place some obstacles to generate a more useful pack.
buildSheet.noSetupSequenceHidden: Numbering is hidden in this export. Enable obstacle numbers if you want the setup sequence to follow route references.
buildSheet.note1: Use the map page as the placement reference during setup and pilot briefing.
buildSheet.note2: Treat the stock check as the source of truth before committing the layout for build.
buildSheet.note3: Anchor the course first, then secure higher-effort structures such as dive gates and ladders before the standard gate pass.
buildSheet.note4: If the route or obstacle count changes, regenerate the Race Pack so the map, stock list, and setup sequence stay aligned.

bom.title: Bill of materials
bom.structureGapsNote: Distances between neighbouring structures, measured on the floor. Each structure is linked to its nearest neighbours, so every piece has at least one gap to set out. Edge gap is the clear space between the two footprints; centre distance is measured between their centres.

contents.routeMap: 2D route map with the lap start, obstacle numbers, and centre-to-centre distances.
contents.viewRoute: {view}, with the race line and direction arrows.
contents.viewObstacles: {view}, obstacles only, for the build crew.
contents.flythrough: {seconds}-second looping animation of a whoop flying the lap through the obstacles.
contents.csv: The same bill of materials as a spreadsheet.

partsPage.title: Parts list
partsPage.noFittings: No fittings are needed for these frames.
partsPage.unbuildableWarning: {count, plural, one {1 joint needs six sockets, which common 20 mm fittings cannot provide.} other {# joints need six sockets, which common 20 mm fittings cannot provide.}}
partsPage.note1: Push every tube fully into its fitting before standing a frame up, then check that all feet touch the floor.
partsPage.note2: Set the frames out in numbered order and measure the centre-to-centre distances from the route map.
partsPage.note3: Regenerate this pack after moving frames or editing the race line so map, views, and parts stay aligned.

warnings.animationFailed: The lap animation could not be rendered ({message}), so the archive has no GIF.
warnings.noRoute: This design has no race line, so the archive has no lap animation and no race-line views.
